general_tips: Maintain momentum, be careful with throttle inputs.
Get a short shift to third.
Pit limiter on before the yellow cone.
Overtaking is difficult but possible at three opportunities.
set up an overtake going into turn number four
take the inside line into turn number two
focus on our exit out of turn number three
